crossRefs.note: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Ten young men who bore Joab’s armor surrounded and struck Absalom, and killed him.
translations.bsb: And ten young men who carried Joab’s armor surrounded Absalom, struck him, and killed him.
translations.kjv: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.
translations.asv: And ten young men that bare Joab's armor compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.
